study: spec 017: the standing time-late control and the shifted-prior gap
decision_rule: none. Research 'As registered': the attainable share's interval and its dependence on the threshold make a rule at this sample a coin's toss; estimands and forecasts are registered instead
statistic: per period, the median relative range error over scored rows (30 s apart, known-history bound below 0.5); a ratio a ÷ b is the geometric mean over periods with a 95% period bootstrap (2,000 resamples, seed 17, percentile), reported with the median per-period ratio and the shares of periods over twice as bad on each side

estimands.E1: share of whole true manoeuvres with detectability under 10, 20, 40 (Wilson intervals), by split
estimands.E2: share of whole true manoeuvres missed (matched within 120 s) by detectability band, for ctl-d1-q0.01, search3, true, c2
estimands.E4: ctl-d1-q0.01 ÷ ref-dT at T = 10, 20, 40 (an upper limit on what detection could win: the reference's times are the truth)
estimands.beside: the attainable share (gap_split) at each threshold; imm and ekf read as tracks; on the outlier split the references fitted to edited bearings; efficiency against the bound; counts at 60, 120, 240 s

soundness: validation seed 343, Annex B: history-fixed range efficiency on rows bounded below 0.05 within [0.8, 1.3]; at least 0.9 of true-history fits with a consistent cost; at most 0.25 of references drifting when free. Fails: the study stops before the test seed
recommendation_logic: a proposer study (study L's trained models inside the search) is recommended only if, on the test seed's shifted split, E4 at threshold 20 has a lower limit above 1.10 AND the control misses more than a third of the manoeuvres with detectability above 40. Otherwise: write the time-late track up and name what would add information. The owner decides either way

forecasts (restatements of tuning seed 3.E2 shifted, control: about 0.95 under 10, 0.65 at 10 to 20, 0.5 at 20 to 40, 0.3 at 40 to 100, 0.12 above 100
forecasts (restatements of tuning seed 3.E4 shifted: 1.59 / 1.25 / 0.93; at 20 the lower limit is not above 1.10
forecasts (restatements of tuning seed 3.E5 shifted: 1.0 (0.9 to 1.2): the true prior finds more manoeuvres and does not improve the track
forecasts (restatements of tuning seed 3.recommendation: no proposer study: E4's lower limit at 20 below 1.10 (about two chances in three), and the control's miss rate above 40 under a third (0.18 on tuning)

known_limits: detectability and the references hold manoeuvre times at the truth: both flatter the references, so E4 is an upper limit and E3 a lower limit on identifiability
two close manoeuvres can each read undetectable while the pair is detectable
thresholds are in χ² and tied to the evidence's price under Annex B's prior
the control is study L's, unchanged, with its recorded limits; run4 has no unit test of its own
